pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
Excels at controlling hostile mobs with vines and providing sustained regen. Ideal for outdoor adventures.

HP: 120. Regen IV + Resistance II.

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
Radius: 32 blocks.
• Slowness IV on hostile mobs (expires on leaving range)
• Threat Marking: hostile land mobs highlighted (spectral-arrow outline)
• Owner: continuous Regen I within range
• Attracts nearby untamed animals

Offhand Thorns Shield: 100% damage reflection.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text: Craft the Forest Doll Head, then the Forest Doll Egg. Name the egg on an anvil to summon.
